description: Holds stock correction details records (defined in the EF Core model), linked to products, stock correction header.
business_purpose: Used to track and report stock correction details records, including amounts and quantities, for the Factory & Inventory area.
record_granularity: One row represents one stock correction detail.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the stock correction detail.

columns.name: correction_headerId
columns.description: Reference to the stock correction header linked to this stock correction detail.

columns.name: productId
columns.description: Reference to the products linked to this stock correction detail.

columns.name: product_name_type
columns.description: Product name type of the stock correction detail.

columns.name: size
columns.description: Size of the stock correction detail.

columns.name: grade
columns.description: Grade of the stock correction detail.

columns.name: thickeness
columns.description: Thickeness of the stock correction detail.

columns.name: product_wise_notional_area
columns.description: Product wise notional area of the stock correction detail.

columns.name: beforeqty
columns.description: Beforeqty of the stock correction detail.

columns.name: qty
columns.description: Qty of the stock correction detail.

columns.name: total_amount
columns.description: Total amount of the stock correction detail.

columns.name: total_weight
columns.description: Total weight of the stock correction detail.

relationships.description: Each stock correction detail references one stock correction header (correction header).
Each stock correction detail references one products (product).

business_rules: Use total_amount / total_weight for monetary or quantity totals.
Columns product_name_type classify the record; check the distinct values before filtering on them.
Join to Products, Stock Correction Header through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
StockCorrectionDetails is defined in the EF Core model but was not found in the connected database, so it may not be deployed there.

common_metrics.name: Average Product Wise Notional Area per stock correction detail

common_queries: Stock Correction Details by stock correction header
Stock Correction Details count by product name type
Top stock correction header by product wise notional area

known_issues: product_wise_notional_area, total_amount, total_weight are stored as floating point, so sums can carry small rounding differences.
product_wise_notional_area, beforeqty are nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against StockCorrectionDetails: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting stock correction detail records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(total_amount) for totals of total amount.
To resolve names, join on: correction_headerId = StockCorrectionHeader.Id; productId = Products.id.
Defined in the EF Core model but not found in the connected database; confirm it has been migrated before relying on it.
